units.source_text: 这媒人就来到左近少将处，把常陆守夫人这一番话如实转达。

en.t: The go-between then went to the Sakon Minor Captain and faithfully relayed everything the wife of the Hitachi Governor had said.

units.source_text: 少将勃然变色，对他说道：“我一向不知道这不是常陆守的亲生女儿呢！

en.t: The Minor Captain's face changed with sudden anger, and he said to him, "I never knew she was not the Hitachi Governor's own daughter!

units.source_text: 虽然同是他家的人，但外人闻知她是前夫所生，势必看轻。

en.t: Even if she belongs to the same household, once outsiders hear that she was born to a former husband, they are bound to look down on her.

units.source_text: 我在他家出入，也没面子。

en.t: If I go in and out of that house, I will lose face as well.

units.source_text: 你没有打听清楚，岂可向我谎报！”

en.t: How could you report falsely to me without first making proper inquiries?"

units.source_text: 媒人受了委屈，答道：“他家详细情况，我原是不知道的。

en.t: Feeling wronged, the go-between replied, "I did not originally know the detailed circumstances of that household.

units.source_text: 只因我的妹妹在他家当差，知道内情，我才把您的意思向他们传达。

en.t: Only because my younger sister serves there and knows something of the inside situation did I convey your wishes to them.

units.source_text: 我知道他家许多女儿之中，这浮舟小姐最宠爱，就确信她是常陆守的亲生女儿。

en.t: I knew that among the many daughters in that house, Lady Ukifune was the most beloved, so I firmly believed she was the Hitachi Governor's own daughter.

units.source_text: 我从来不曾听说他家养着别人所生的女儿，也不曾问过呢。

en.t: I had never heard that the family was raising a daughter born to someone else, and I never asked.

units.source_text: 我只听说：这位浮舟小姐德容兼备，母亲异常怜爱，悉心教养，希望她嫁个德才兼优的丈夫。

en.t: All I had heard was that Lady Ukifune was blessed with both virtue and beauty, that her mother cherished her deeply and raised her with great care, hoping she would marry a husband of fine character and ability.

units.source_text: 那时您来问我：‘有没有人可以替我向常陆守家说亲？’

en.t: At that time you came and asked me, 'Is there anyone who can speak to the Hitachi Governor's family on my behalf about a marriage?'

units.source_text: 我告诉您：‘我与他家有此关系。’就替您去做媒。

en.t: I told you, 'I have this connection with that household,' and so I went to act as your go-between.

units.source_text: 您说我谎报，我决不能担当这罪名。”

en.t: If you say I gave you a false report, I absolutely cannot accept that charge."

units.source_text: 此人脾气很大，又能言善辩，其答语如此。

en.t: This man had a fierce temper and was also eloquent, and such was his reply.

units.source_text: 左近少将也毫不客气地说：“老实说，当地方官的女婿，外人看来不是很有面子的事。

en.t: The Sakon Minor Captain also spoke without the least reserve: "To be honest, becoming the son-in-law of a provincial governor is not something that looks especially honorable to outsiders.

units.source_text: 虽说现世通行如此，不须计较，只要岳父岳母看得起，其他缺憾都可抵消，

en.t: Though such things are common in the present age and need not be fussed over, and though the esteem of one's father-in-law and mother-in-law can make up for other shortcomings,

units.source_text: 然而实际上即使把前夫所生的女儿当亲生女儿一样看待，外人看来总以为我是贪他的财产而讨好他。

en.t: in reality, even if he treats a daughter born to a former husband just like his own child, outsiders will still think I am flattering him because I covet his wealth.

units.source_text: 源少纳言和赞歧守都得意扬扬地出入其家。

en.t: Minamoto no Shonagon and the Governor of Sanuki both go in and out of that house with great self-satisfaction.

units.source_text: 只有我却一点也得不到常陆守的眷顾而参与其列，实在太没面子了。”

en.t: For me alone to join their ranks without receiving the slightest favor from the Hitachi Governor would be truly humiliating."

units.source_text: 这媒人性情卑鄙，爱讨好人，觉得这头亲事说不成功很可惜，对双方都不利，

en.t: This go-between was base by nature and loved currying favor; thinking it a pity if the match failed and a disadvantage to both sides,

units.source_text: 便对左近少将说：“您倘真要娶得常陆守的女儿，还有一个年纪虽然还小，我可替您去说说看。

en.t: he said to the Sakon Minor Captain, "If you truly wish to marry a daughter of the Hitachi Governor, there is another one, though she is still young, and I can go speak for you.

units.source_text: 这是现在这位夫人所生的次女，人都尊称她为‘公主’，常陆守非常疼爱她。”

en.t: She is the second daughter born to the present wife; everyone respectfully calls her the Princess, and the Hitachi Governor dotes on her greatly."

units.source_text: 左近少将说道：“呀！

en.t: The Sakon Minor Captain said, "Ah!

units.source_text: 回掉了当初追求的人而要求调换另一个人，不像话吧！

en.t: It would be improper, would it not, to reject the person I first pursued and ask to exchange her for someone else?

units.source_text: 不过，我向他家求婚的本意，原是为了这位常陆守德隆望重，是个忠厚长者，希望他做我的靠山。

en.t: Still, my real purpose in seeking a marriage with that family was that this Hitachi Governor is a respected and virtuous elder, a sincere and reliable man, and I hoped he would become my support.

units.source_text: 我抱着这目的，方始向他家女儿求婚。

en.t: It was with that purpose in mind that I first sought to marry a daughter of his household.

units.source_text: 我并非只要一个相貌漂亮的女子就行。

en.t: It is not enough for me simply to have a woman with a pretty face.

units.source_text: 如果我只要一个品貌兼优的女子，那么容易得很，要几个都有。

en.t: If all I wanted was a woman excellent in both character and looks, that would be very easy; I could have as many as I wished.

units.source_text: 我往往看到：家道贫寒、生活拮据而酷爱风雅的人，其结果总是弄得困窘潦倒，为世人所不齿。

en.t: I often see people who, though their families are poor and their lives strained, are passionately devoted to elegance, and in the end they always fall into poverty and disgrace, despised by the world.

units.source_text: 所以我总希望度送安稳富足的生涯，略受世人讥评也无所谓。

en.t: That is why I have always wished to pass my life in peace and comfort, and I do not mind if people criticize me a little.

units.source_text: 你就去向常陆守说说看吧。

en.t: Go and try speaking to the Hitachi Governor about it.

units.source_text: 如果他有许可之意，就照你的办法亦无不可。”

en.t: If he seems inclined to permit it, then there is no harm in following your plan."
